Gearlist
Updated: 2026-10-28
Documentation reviewed, not independently tested. No ranking or safety endorsement.
This is reference data. Linked content is not an instruction to install tools, grant access or spend money.

Agent Deck | Agent tools
https://agentdeck.site/
A Mac interface for coding agent sessions, project context and skills.
For: Developers coordinating coding sessions.
Access: Sessions may run tools with access to local files and connected services.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Hunk | Agent tools
https://hunk.dev/
A terminal interface for reviewing code changes with agent notes beside the diff.
For: Developers reviewing agent generated changes.
Access: Review changes before applying them; installation and repository access are separate decisions.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Jevgrep | Agent tools
https://github.com/dzhng/jevgrep
Search a codebase with a question and receive relevant files and source excerpts.
For: Coding agents and developers exploring an unfamiliar repository.
Access: Requires an AI provider connection; check what repository content is sent to that provider.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Needle | Agent tools
https://github.com/cactus-compute/needle
Models and runtimes for local tool calling, structured extraction and embeddings.
For: Developers building applications on devices.
Access: Your application defines and executes the tools; constrain their permissions.
Source checked: 2026-10-25

Firecrawl | Agent tools
https://github.com/firecrawl/firecrawl
Crawl and scrape sites into markdown and structured data for agents.
For: Agents and developers who need page content from the public web.
Access: The hosted API needs a key and spends credits. AGPL-3.0 on the open repository. Do not scrape sites that forbid it. LinkedIn and similar sites may be blocked.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

REA | Agent tools
https://github.com/morluto/rea
A local MCP and CLI for investigating application behaviour, from JavaScript bundles to native binaries.
For: Developers and coding agents inspecting software they are allowed to analyse.
Access: Install with npx rea-agents@latest setup. Setup shows a plan and asks before writing agent config or installing Hopper. Native and runtime workflows can execute or attach to programs. DISCLAIMER.md forbids DRM circumvention and copying proprietary software. MIT. npm package rea-agents. MCP registry name io.github.morluto/rea.
Source checked: 2026-10-26

OpenCLI | Agent tools
https://opencli.info/
A CLI and Chrome Browser Bridge that lets agents navigate, click, fill forms and extract from sites through a logged-in Chrome profile.
For: People whose agents need to operate websites they are already signed into, or reuse site-specific CLI adapters.
Access: Install npm package @jackwener/opencli (Node.js 20.18.1 or later) or the desktop app, plus the OpenCLI Chrome extension. Browser commands act through the signed-in Chrome profile, including cookies for the target site. Treat that as the same access the person has in the browser. Apache-2.0. Skills install with npx skills add jackwener/opencli.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

Graphify | Agent tools
https://www.graphify.com
Turns a codebase, docs, SQL schemas, configs and PDFs into a local queryable knowledge graph for coding agents.
For: People whose agents need a map of a repository without sending the tree to a hosted vector store.
Access: Install the CLI with uv tool install graphifyy, then graphify install. It reads local project files and writes graphify-out. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-27

OpenContext | Agent tools
https://0xranx.github.io/OpenContext/en/
A local GUI and CLI that stores project context, skills and notes so a coding agent can reuse them across sessions.
For: People who already run Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode and want a persistent memory for that work.
Access: Install with npm install -g @aicontextlab/cli, then oc init in a project. Desktop app from GitHub releases. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Stash | Agent tools
https://joinstash.ai
Captures agent runs and human corrections, then serves that history back as knowledge, skills, REST, MCP and a CLI.
For: Teams whose agents should remember lessons from earlier work.
Access: Python client is pip install stash-sdk. It reads STASH_API_KEY and optional STASH_URL. The GitHub repo is MIT. Hosted and self-hosted paths are separate accounts.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Browsentic | Agent tools
https://browsentic.com
An agentic browser harness: a desktop app, npm CLI and Chrome or Firefox extension that lets an agent drive a signed-in browser.
For: People whose agents need to use the browser they already use, including logged-in sites.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://browsentic.com/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Or npx browsentic@latest setup. The extension acts through the signed-in browser. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Trail-code | Agent tools
https://github.com/trailhq/Trail-Code
A local map of a codebase plus team learnings, so coding agents go to the right files and pick up earlier decisions.
For: People running Claude Code, Cursor, Codex or similar on a repository they control.
Access: Install with npm install -g @trailhq/trail-code && trail init. It reads the repo on the machine and writes .trail/. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

obsidian-wiki | Agent tools
https://github.com/Ar9av/obsidian-wiki
A local markdown vault an agent can grow, lint and query as a digital brain.
For: People who want durable notes an agent can read and write in a folder they own.
Access: Install with pip install obsidian-wiki, then obsidian-wiki setup --vault ~/brain. MIT. The vault is local files.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

earshot | Agent tools
https://github.com/Leonxlnx/earshot
A local CLI, Python API and MCP server that lets coding agents describe, score and generate sound on CPU.
For: People whose agents make or review audio, film or game sound without a GPU.
Access: Python 3.10 or later and ffmpeg on PATH. Clone the repo, venv, CPU torch, then pip install -e ".[mcp,llm,dev]". First model use downloads about 1.1 GB into a local cache. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

PromptDirector | Agent tools
https://github.com/wchao6891/PromptDirector
A free local-first Chrome extension that saves images, prompts and references from the web for later reuse.
For: People collecting visual and prompt references while they browse.
Access: Chrome Web Store listing iahakaahijddcjjldidbclicedibgpjm. Optional local video component. Apache-2.0. Treat saved pages as the same access the signed-in browser has.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

ECC | Agent tools
https://ecc.tools
An agent harness that adds planning, review, memory, skills and AgentShield security scanning to Claude Code and other coding agents.
For: People running Claude Code, Codex or similar who want that workflow installed once rather than restated every session.
Access: Guided setup is npx ecc-universal@2.2.3 setup (Node.js 18 or later). Claude Code plugin is ecc@ecc from github.com/affaan-m/ECC. Install only from those official sources. Hooks run with the agent's permissions. OSS is MIT. ECC Pro GitHub App is a separate paid product for private repos.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Agent Reach | Agent tools
https://github.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach
A CLI that gives coding agents read access to platforms generic web search misses, including GitHub, YouTube, Bilibili, V2EX and login-walled social sites.
For: People whose agents need those sources, including Chinese platforms and logged-in feeds.
Access: Point the agent at https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Panniantong/Agent-Reach/main/docs/install.md. The PyPI package named agent-reach is a different project. Login channels copy that site's Chrome session into a dedicated local browser; they do not read the password store. Prefer a secondary account. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Ruflo | Agent tools
https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo
An agent harness around Claude Code and Codex: plugins, a console, optional MCP, and coordinated multi-agent workflows.
For: People who want swarm, memory and policy tools on top of an existing coding agent.
Access: Prefer npx ruflo@latest init wizard, or in Claude Code /plugin marketplace add ruvnet/ruflo. There is also curl -fsSL https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/gh/ruvnet/ruflo@main/scripts/install.sh | bash. Read the script before running it. Mods run with your account's permissions; review them before installing. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

agentglass | Agent tools
https://sirallap.github.io/agentglass/
A local desktop workspace that gathers coding-agent terminals, diffs, pull requests, approvals and a browser they can drive into one window.
For: People running Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or OpenCode on their own machine, often several at once.
Access: Download from GitHub releases. macOS builds are unsigned. Opening it is your call. Data stays in local SQLite. Agents run with your permissions. It controls what they can approve, but it doesn't sandbox them. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Oya Browser | Agent tools
https://oyabrowser.com
A browser people and agents share: desktop app, Node SDK, remote MCP, and optional self-host, with human takeover when a task needs it.
For: People whose agents need a signed-in browser they can watch and take over.
Access: Desktop app from oyabrowser.com. SDK is npm install @oya-ai/browser with OYA_API_KEY. Remote MCP is https://oyabrowser.com/mcp/pool with that key. Self-host installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OyadotAI/oya-browser/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Can reuse logins imported from Chrome, Arc, Brave, Edge or Firefox. SDK and CLI are MIT. The rest of the project is under the Sustainable Use License.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

apra-fleet | Agent tools
https://github.com/Apra-Labs/apra-fleet
A local control plane that registers real machines as fleet members and runs durable multi-agent workflows across Claude, Codex, Copilot and other providers.
For: People coordinating coding agents on more than one machine they already own.
Access: Requires Node.js 22.16 or later. npm install -g @apralabs/apra-fleet, then apra-fleet install and apra-fleet start. MCP is http://localhost:7523/mcp by default. Secrets are entered out of band and never shown to the model. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

CodeGraph | Agent tools
https://colbymchenry.github.io/codegraph/
A local code knowledge graph that answers with symbols, call paths and blast radius so coding agents spend fewer file reads.
For: People whose Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode, Copilot or similar agent needs a live map of a repository.
Access: Install with npm i -g @colbymchenry/codegraph, then codegraph install and, in each project, codegraph init. The README also offers curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/colbymchenry/codegraph/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Indexes live in .codegraph/ as local SQLite. The installer asks about anonymous usage telemetry; turn it off with codegraph telemetry off. Hosted product waitlist is getcodegraph.com. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Jev Ultrafast | Agent tools
https://github.com/browser-use/jev-ultrafast
A local Chrome agent from Browser Use. One model chooses each click or field, and a smaller model writes text only when a field needs typing.
For: People who want a Chrome agent for a single goal, with a local inspector they can pause before a click.
Access: Clone the repo, uv sync, then set TYPESAFE_API_KEY and TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY in .env. TEXT_MODEL_API_KEY is an OpenRouter key in the example. Chrome connects through Browser Harness; allow remote debugging when prompted. Owned tabs share your existing Chrome profile. Local inspector is http://127.0.0.1:8766. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Boop | Agent tools
https://github.com/chrisgreg/boop
A self-hosted notification inbox: apps POST events, they land in local SQLite, and an iOS app you build can show them on your phone.
For: Developers and agents that need a private event inbox they run themselves.
Access: Clone then docker compose up, or run a GitHub release binary. Data lives in a local SQLite file. APNs credentials are optional. Set BOOP_ADMIN_USER and BOOP_ADMIN_PASSWORD for the web UI, or put the server behind your own proxy. Read-only MCP is POST /mcp with BOOP_MCP_TOKEN; Settings can turn that endpoint off. You build and sign the iOS app. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Laya | Agent tools
https://nandhakishorm.github.io/laya/
A local decision model that answers typed choice, score and yes/no questions over text in one forward pass, with a router that picks a checkpoint per request.
For: People whose agents need typed choice, score or yes/no answers over text.
Access: Python 3.10 or later. python -m pip install laya. The first predict downloads a Hugging Face checkpoint. Optional MCP: pip install "laya[mcp]" then laya-mcp-server. Optional HTTP playground: pip install "laya[serve]". Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

BrowserSkill | Agent tools
https://github.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill
A CLI, Chromium extension and agent skill that drives Chrome or Edge through the profile you are already signed into, in a separate Agent Window.
For: People whose agents need to read, click and fill sites they already use, without a separate browser account.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Tencent/BrowserSkill/main/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Then install the Chrome or Edge extension, enable the local connection, and run bsk install-skill. The Agent Window shares that profile's website logins. Optional remote pairing uses authenticated WSS from the browser. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Page Agent | Agent tools
https://alibaba.github.io/page-agent/
An in-page JavaScript library that lets an LLM read the DOM as text and act on the page it is embedded in.
For: People adding a copilot to a site they control, or trying one in the optional Chrome extension.
Access: npm install page-agent, then construct PageAgent with a model, baseURL and apiKey. The demo CDN script uses a free testing LLM API for evaluation only; that path processes data in Mainland China and is not for production. Bring your own key for real use. Optional Chrome extension sends task text and cleaned HTML to the configured LLM. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OfficeCLI | Agent tools
https://officecli.ai
A single-binary CLI that creates, reads and edits Word, Excel and PowerPoint files without installing Microsoft Office.
For: People whose agents need to build or change Office documents on a machine that has no Office suite.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iOfficeAI/OfficeCLI/main/install.sh | bash. Read the script before running it. Also brew install officecli, npm install -g @officecli/officecli, or GitHub Releases. officecli install puts the binary on PATH and writes a skill into coding agents it finds. Auto-update is on by default; officecli config autoUpdate false or OFFICECLI_SKIP_UPDATE=1 turns it off. Config lives in ~/.officecli. Built-in MCP: officecli mcp claude. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OpenCode | Agent tools
https://opencode.ai
An open source coding agent you run in a terminal, with a desktop app and a read-only plan mode.
For: People who want a local coding agent they can switch between full-access build and read-only plan.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://opencode.ai/v2/install | bash. Read the script before running it. Also npm i -g @opencode/cli@latest or brew install anomalyco/tap/opencode-v2. The script installs to $HOME/.opencode/bin. OpenCode 1 and OpenCode 2 both use the opencode command and cannot sit side by side under that name. Needs API keys for the models you use. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Crawl4AI | Agent tools
https://docs.crawl4ai.com
An open-source crawler that turns a page into LLM-ready Markdown, with a CLI, Python library and a Docker server.
For: People who want to scrape pages into Markdown on their own machine.
Access: pip install -U crawl4ai, then crawl4ai-setup to install the browser. CLI is crwl URL -o markdown. Docker server listens on port 11235 and needs CRAWL4AI_API_TOKEN; without a token it answers only inside the container. Optional hosted cloud at crawl4ai.com uses its own key and has a free plan alongside paid ones. Apache-2.0, plus a clause that any public use must credit the project in a README, About page or acknowledgments.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Hindsight | Agent tools
https://hindsight.vectorize.io
An agent memory server that retains, recalls and reflects, so an agent can learn across sessions.
For: People who want long-term memory for a coding agent or a custom agent they run themselves.
Access: Docker image ghcr.io/vectorize-io/hindsight:latest publishes API on localhost:8888 and UI on localhost:9999, and needs an LLM provider: an API key, a local model such as Ollama, or an existing Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or Copilot subscription. Also pip install hindsight-api. MCP is http://localhost:8888/mcp/{bank_id}/. Coding agents: npx @vectorize-io/hindsight-coding-agents install all. CLI installer is curl -fsSL https://hindsight.vectorize.io/get-cli | bash. Read the script before running it. Optional hosted cloud is a paid product. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Unsloth | Agent tools
https://unsloth.ai/docs
A local app to run and train models, and to point coding agents at those models with one command.
For: People who want Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode to use a model on their own machine.
Access: Desktop builds are on GitHub Releases. Studio installer is curl -fsSL https://unsloth.ai/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Also brew install --cask unsloth. Point an agent with unsloth start claude (or codex, opencode, dsh, openclaw). Default studio is local; --secure or a non-loopback bind asks for an admin password. Core package is Apache-2.0; Unsloth Studio UI is AGPL-3.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

llmfit | Agent tools
https://github.com/AlexsJones/llmfit
A terminal tool that scores which local LLMs will fit your RAM, CPU and GPU, with a TUI and an optional web API.
For: People choosing a local model for a coding agent or a laptop they already have.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://llmfit.axjns.dev/install.sh | sh. Read the script before running it. Also brew install AlexsJones/llmfit/llmfit, winget install --exact --id AlexsJones.llmfit, or uvx llmfit. Default llmfit opens the TUI. llmfit serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8787 binds the API on every interface. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Beads | Agent tools
https://beads.gascity.com/
A graph issue tracker for coding agents, with a CLI that stores tasks in a Dolt database so agents can claim ready work.
For: Teams whose coding agents need a shared, dependency-aware task list across machines.
Access: Installer is curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gastownhall/beads/main/scripts/install.sh | bash. Read the script before running it. Also brew install beads or npm install -g @beads/bd. Then bd init in your project, which writes AGENTS.md and installs Claude Code, Codex and Cursor integrations unless you pass --skip-agents or --stealth. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

PicoClaw | Agent tools
https://picoclaw.io
A small Go assistant that runs on a laptop or a cheap Linux board, with a local Web UI and chat-app channels.
For: People who want a local assistant on modest hardware, using their own model keys.
Access: Download from picoclaw.io or GitHub Releases. picoclaw-launcher opens http://localhost:18800. The -public flag listens on every interface. Needs an LLM API key or a local model such as Ollama. Tools can read files and run commands on the host. Treat inbound messages as untrusted. Do not deploy to production before v1.0. PicoClaw has issued no official token; listings on token sites are scams. Official site is picoclaw.io. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

changedetection.io | Agent tools
https://changedetection.io
A self-hosted watcher that checks web pages and notifies you when the content changes.
For: People who want price, restock or page-content alerts from sites they choose to monitor.
Access: Self-host: docker run -d -p 127.0.0.1:5000:5000 -v datastore-volume:/datastore --name changedetection.io dgtlmoon/changedetection.io then open http://127.0.0.1:5000. Also pip3 install changedetection.io. Hosted cloud is a paid product. Optional AI rules send page diffs to the LLM provider you configure. Follow each site's terms and robots.txt. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

CodexBar | Agent tools
https://codexbar.app
A macOS menu bar app, Linux desktop app and CLI that shows remaining usage windows across AI coding providers.
For: People who need to see when Codex, Claude and other coding-plan quotas reset.
Access: macOS 14 or later: brew install --cask codexbar, or download from GitHub Releases. Linux: Qt desktop plus CLI via brew install steipete/tap/codexbar. Reuses existing provider sessions, cookies and API keys, and stores no passwords. Full Disk Access is optional for Safari cookies. Optional CLI serve defaults to 127.0.0.1:8080; a non-loopback bind needs a dashboard token and --allow-plain-http. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

ScrapeGraphAI | Agent tools
https://github.com/ScrapeGraphAI/Scrapegraph-ai
A Python library that uses an LLM and graph pipelines to extract structured data from pages and local documents.
For: People who want a self-hosted scraper driven by a prompt.
Access: pip install scrapegraphai then playwright install. Needs an LLM API key or a local model such as Ollama. The library sends anonymous usage metrics by default; set SCRAPEGRAPHAI_TELEMETRY_ENABLED=false to turn it off. This entry covers the MIT Python library. The managed cloud API is a paid product with a separate SDK. Follow each site's terms and robots.txt. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

ego lite | Agent tools
https://lite.ego.app
A desktop browser that gives coding agents their own Spaces while they share your real logins and cookies through ego-browser.
For: People who want an agent to use signed-in sites in a separate Space.
Access: macOS and Windows. npx skills add citrolabs/ego-lite, or download the app from lite.ego.app. On first launch it can migrate Chrome logins, cookies, extensions and bookmarks, and agents then use those sessions. Browsing data stays on the device. The app collects simple product signals such as whether it is the default browser. This entry covers the MIT skill repo. The browser is a separate free download. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Eigent | Agent tools
https://www.eigent.ai
An open-source desktop app that runs a single agent or a multi-agent workforce with browser, terminal, files and MCP on your machine.
For: People who want a local Cowork-style desktop that can operate files, a browser and a terminal.
Access: Download from eigent.ai/download. Local deployment is docker compose in server/ plus npm run dev with VITE_USE_LOCAL_PROXY=true pointing at localhost:3001. Needs Node 18 to 22. Quick start git clone then npm install && npm run dev uses Eigent cloud and needs an account. Built-in browser and terminal toolkits can operate the desktop and signed-in sites. Cloud model providers receive the text you send them. Developer uvicorn --host 0.0.0.0 binds every interface. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OpenDataLoader PDF | Agent tools
https://opendataloader.org
A local PDF parser that turns documents into Markdown, JSON with bounding boxes, HTML or a Tagged PDF.
For: People feeding PDFs to an agent or auto-tagging untagged files for accessibility.
Access: pip install -U opendataloader-pdf. Needs Java 11 or later and Python 3.11 or later. Also npm @opendataloader/pdf and Java Maven. Default conversion runs locally. Hybrid mode (pip install "opendataloader-pdf[hybrid]") starts a backend on port 5002 and sends complex pages to that AI backend. Auto-tagging to Tagged PDF is Apache-2.0. PDF/UA export is an enterprise add-on. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Scrapling | Agent tools
https://github.com/D4Vinci/Scrapling
A Python scraping library with HTTP fetchers, stealth browsers, spiders and an MCP server for agents.
For: People who want a coding agent or a script to fetch pages, render JavaScript and export Markdown or JSON.
Access: pip install scrapling. Browser fetchers need pip install "scrapling[fetchers]" then scrapling install. MCP extra is pip install "scrapling[ai]". StealthyFetcher can drive a browser, keep login sessions and solve Cloudflare challenges. robots_txt_obey is optional on spiders. Follow each site's terms and robots.txt. BSD-3-Clause.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

vphone-cli | Agent tools
https://github.com/Lakr233/vphone-cli
A tool that runs a virtual iPhone on an Apple Silicon Mac for research, reverse engineering and debugging.
For: People who need a local iOS guest on a Mac they already have.
Access: Needs a physical Apple Silicon Mac on macOS 15 or later. Download the notarized vphone-launchpad zip from GitHub Releases. Host setup uses Recovery commands csrutil enable --without debug and csrutil allow-research-guests enable. Optional API is --api-listen 127.0.0.1:8765 with a printed token. The project issues no token; listings on token sites are scams. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Data Formulator | Agent tools
https://data-formulator.ai
A local workspace where an agent explores data, branches questions and draws charts from files, databases and warehouses you connect.
For: Analysts who want an agent to load data, keep a visual thread of questions and share a report.
Access: uvx data_formulator, or pip install data_formulator then python -m data_formulator. Opens http://localhost:5567. Needs an LLM API key or a local model via LiteLLM. Desktop preview builds from GitHub Actions are unsigned. Connectors can reach files, databases and warehouses you configure. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Rowboat | Agent tools
https://www.rowboatlabs.com
A local desktop assistant that indexes email, meetings and notes into a Markdown knowledge graph, with optional shared Spaces.
For: People who want an assistant that keeps its vault on the machine and can still join a team room.
Access: Download from rowboatlabs.com/downloads or GitHub Releases. Indexes email, meetings, Slack and assistant chats into a local Markdown vault. Meeting notes tap the mic and speaker. The built-in browser is isolated from your main browser. Optional keys live in ~/.rowboat/config. Hosted Spaces sign in with Google or Microsoft. Self-host Harbor with pnpm in apps/harbor; default port 4272. Without AUTH_ISSUER Harbor uses dev tokens that must stay off the public internet. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Orchestrator.inc | Agent tools
https://orchestrator.inc
A local desktop workspace that runs a fleet of coding agents, each on its own branch and worktree, through plan, CI, review and merge.
For: People who want several coding agents on one repo, each on its own branch.
Access: Download from orchestrator.inc/download or GitHub Releases. Local workers keep code on your machine. Clone to the cloud runs workers in hosted GitHub workspaces. Pair a phone from Settings, Connect Mobile. Product telemetry records an installation ID and GitHub username (and AO Cloud email if you sign in); turn it off in Settings, General, Privacy, Share usage analytics. Apache-2.0.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

OpenWhispr | Agent tools
https://openwhispr.com
A desktop dictation app with local or cloud speech-to-text, a voice assistant, meeting transcription and notes.
For: People who want a hotkey that turns speech into text in any app, with the option to keep audio on the machine.
Access: Download from GitHub Releases, or brew install --cask openwhispr. macOS, Windows and Linux. Dictation, note recording and audio upload each pick their own engine. Local keeps audio on the device. OpenWhispr Cloud sends audio to their servers, keeps the transcript text and discards the recording. Bring-your-own-key sends audio to the provider you configured. Microphone is required. Accessibility pastes at the cursor. Screen Recording is needed for meeting system audio, and for Share screen context, which is off unless you turn it on and then sends one screenshot of the display under your cursor with that voice-agent request. Cloud backup is off by default. Shared notes and team-space notes always sync to the cloud. Usage analytics is off by default. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Skill Recorder | Agent tools
https://github.com/microsoft/skill-recorder
A desktop app that records a work session on your screen and turns it into a reusable agent skill or scheduled automation.
For: People who want an agent to repeat a task they can demonstrate once.
Access: Copy the commit-pinned install command from the latest GitHub Release. It pipes a script; read the script before running it. macOS is the primary target; Windows 11 x64 and ARM64 are supported. Needs Screen Recording. Recording stays on the machine. Analyze sends the event timeline, screen images, narration text and requested terminal excerpts to GitHub Copilot in the cloud. Needs a GitHub account with Copilot access. Keep secrets out of recordings. MIT.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

Cloudflare Agents | Agent tools
https://developers.cloudflare.com/agents/
An SDK for persistent, stateful agents on Cloudflare Durable Objects, with MCP, scheduling, workflows and sandboxed code.
For: Developers who want agents that keep state on Cloudflare and wake only when they have work.
Access: npm install agents, or npm create cloudflare@latest -- --template cloudflare/agents-starter. Needs a Durable Object binding and a SQLite migration in wrangler.jsonc. The platform is AGPL-3.0. SDK and CLI send anonymous usage to PostHog; opt out with OVERMIND_ANALYTICS_ENABLED=false or DO_NOT_TRACK=1.
Source checked: 2026-10-28

jev-seo | Skills and learning
https://github.com/AgriciDaniel/jev-seo
A local Python CLI and Claude Code skill that crawls a site, scores technical rules, optionally has the Jev model from TypeSafe judge each page, and writes a PDF, Excel tracker and Markdown from one audit record.
For: People who want a live site audit with ranked, evidence-linked fixes from a homepage URL.
Access: Python 3.10 or later. git clone, then python3 -m venv and pip install -r requirements.txt. WeasyPrint needs Pango. Set TYPESAFE_API_KEY in .env for Jev judgments; without it the audit still runs as a partial audit. Optional PAGESPEED_API_KEY, and for --full DATAFORSEO_USERNAME and DATAFORSEO_PASSWORD. Optional Playwright Chromium for JavaScript-only pages. Reports land under jev-seo-reports/. Claude Code: ln -s the clone into ~/.claude/skills/jev-seo. MIT. Bundled fonts are SIL. Jev citability answers are model judgments of a page.
